title: "Did Satellite Section Fall?" - Columbia Basin News, Pasco, Wash., page 2 (June 1958)
description: Newspaper clipping headlined "Did Satellite Section Fall?" reporting that two Hanford engineers who saw a brilliant light fall from the sky concluded they may have seen a piece of a satellite drop, noting "Explorer III was due to fall from its orbit today." The men, traveling south from White Bluffs to the 200 Area, saw the light about 20 degrees above the horizon at 11:16 a.m. A typed source line credits the "Columbia Basin News," Pasco, Wash., page 2; the FBI Seattle stamp is dated JUN 28 1958 with file number 100-18945-69.
